reviewer: Independent regulation_contacts build subagent; manual Hindi semantic review
scope: One synthetic Hindi UI-to-real-provider smoke response. Separate from ten English explanation cases and deterministic classifier results. Reviewer made no provider API calls.
review_note: Faithfully states that the insurer reported a ₹3,250 deduction without a clear reason and that no policy clause/additional detail was provided. It does not invent a deduction reason, policy term, legal breach, medical assessment, or entitlement to payment. In particular, it no longer says the deducted ₹3,250 is payable to the claimant or hospital.
style_note: इंशुरर and नीति क्लॉज़ are understandable in context; बीमाकर्ता and पॉलिसी की शर्त would be more idiomatic plain Hindi. This is a style observation, not a semantic failure.

before.review_note: The earlier response asserted that the deducted ₹3,250 was payable to the claimant or hospital although the only input was an unexplained deduction. That unsupported entitlement is absent in the revised output.

limitations: One Hindi response is a smoke check, not a ten-case Hindi evaluation or proof of accuracy on real documents.
A prompt change can alter later outputs; this review is tied to the exact recorded response hashes.
